channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: British destroyer integrates with French carrier group
item.description: HMS Dauntless has been operating alongside the French Navy during exercise ORION 26, joining the carrier strike group centred on the aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle. The post British destroyer integrates with French carrier group first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British jets in the air in defensive action over Middle East
item.description: British fast jets are flying as part of regional defensive operations in the Middle East, the Defence Secretary has confirmed, following US and Israeli strikes against Iran. The post British jets in the air in defensive action over Middle East first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Iranian missiles shot down near British base
item.description: Two Iranian missiles were fired in the direction of Cyprus but were intercepted, Defence Secretary John Healey has confirmed. The post Iranian missiles shot down near British base first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American forces sink Iranian warship
item.description: An Iranian Navy Jamaran-class warship has been struck by US forces during the opening phase of Operation Epic Fury. The post American forces sink Iranian warship first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British jet shoots down Iranian drone near Qatar
item.description: A Royal Air Force Typhoon operating from Qatar has shot down an Iranian drone heading towards Qatari territory. The post British jet shoots down Iranian drone near Qatar first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Starmer authorises US use of British bases for defensive strikes
item.description: The Prime Minister has confirmed that the United Kingdom will allow the United States to use British bases for specific and limited defensive purposes. The post Starmer authorises US use of British bases for defensive strikes first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Iranian drone impact at British air base, no casualties
item.description: There has been an explosion caused by Iranian drone at RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus. The post Iranian drone impact at British air base, no casualties first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain orders 23 new AW149 helicopters
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed a deal with Leonardo that will see the AW149 selected under the New Medium Helicopter programme. The post Britain orders 23 new AW149 helicopters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American F-15 jet comes down over Kuwait
item.description: Reports circulating online claim that a United States Air Force F-15 has crashed in Kuwait. The post American F-15 jet comes down over Kuwait first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Drone strike at British air base on Cyprus
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that British forces are responding to what it described as a suspected drone strike at RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus. The post Drone strike at British air base on Cyprus first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
